[Intro]
[Em7]

[Verse 1]
[Em7]Damaged pride and vulnerable,
[Dadd11]all my fears are open now
[Cmaj7]Never thought this would hit me so hard
[Em7]Staring at my hollow phone,
[Dadd11]not sure if you're coming home
[Cmaj7]Bed still smells like I'm not all alone
again

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em7]I know we fucked it
[Dadd11]all up this
[Cmaj7]time We got so high
(Couldn't see the bottom) I

[Chorus]
[Cmaj7]just crashed my car
[G]And it got
[Dadd11]me thinking of
[Cmaj7]you So I
[Cmaj7]just thought I'd call
[G]To tell
[Dadd11]you, to tell you I, to
[Cmaj7]tell you I still love you

[Bridge]
[G]My mental image impaired,
undid the braids in my hair
[Em7]I rain destruction in the
fight of my inner feels
[G]Remove the tricks of the trade,
you're just alone on the stage
[Em7]There's no witness, fly your
soul through the windshield

[Verse 2]
[Em7]Damaged pride and vulnerable,
[Dadd11]all my fears are open now
[Cmaj7]Never thought this would hit me so hard
[Em7]Staring at my hollow phone,
[Dadd11]wondering if you've found your home
[Cmaj7]Feel like I deserve to die alone
again

[Pre-Chorus]
[Em7]We really fucked it
[Dadd11]all up this
[Cmaj7]time We got so low
(Only for a second) I

[Chorus]
[Cmaj7]just crashed my car
[G]And it got
[Dadd11]me thinking of
[Cmaj7]you So I
[Cmaj7]just thought I'd call
[G]To tell
[Dadd11]you, to tell you I, to
[Cmaj7]tell you I still love you

[Bridge]
[G]Take a sip from the drain,
the flavor tastes like nothing
[Em7]Or nothing tastes the same 'cause
nothing is never there
[G]I know what I'm talking 'bout,
believe the words in my mouth
[Em7]'Cause I can say that it was
all just a metaphor

[Outro]
[G]In my heart and in my own mind, in my soul
I know that they ain't never gonna break me
[Em7]In my heart and in my own mind, in my soul
I know that they ain't never gonna break me
[G]In my heart and in my own mind, in my soul
I know that they ain't never gonna break me
[Em7]In my heart and in my own mind, in my soul
I know that they ain't never gonna break me
[G]
